messages: Maria S.: Thanks Alex. Logged repro and asked for request/response headers. Can you confirm they used `json_mode=true` and the Redwood client v1.8.0? Also asked for raw response body and request id.

Samir P.: assigning to me. Quick question: is this happening for all prompts or only certain prompt templates? If you can include the exact prompt + system messages that produced the sample output that helps. Could be a templating change in the new tokenizer or output-formatting layer.

Alex K.: Got it. Customer confirms: `json_mode: true`, SDK=python v1.8.0, `model=rwd-v2.3.1`. Prompt: "Return a JSON summary with fields id,status,items where items is a list of objects." I pasted the raw response and request headers in the ticket: INF-2345. Request-id `req_0a9f3b`. Response from inference node: ```HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: req_0a9f3b

{'id': 123, 'status': 'ok', 'items': [ {'name': 'widget', }, ], }
``` They tried 3 retries, same pattern.

Samir P.: Thanks. Repro steps (I ran locally against a staging replica): ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-v2.3.1","json_mode":true,"prompt":"Return a JSON summary with fields id,status,items"}'
``` I see identical invalid output on staging. Initial hypothesis: output-formatter rollback/regression in rwd-v2.3.1 that toggles a different formatting routine under certain tokenization boundaries. Adding `format_strict:true` workarounds the issue and forces the formatter to re-emit valid JSON (but increases latency ~40ms).

Alex K.: Noted. Customer is sensitive to latency — Dedicated SLA expects <200ms p50. They will accept a temporary workaround if we provide an ops-safe knob they can set. Can we expose `format_strict` in the routing layer or suggest pinning to `rwd-v2.3.0`?

Samir P.: We can recommend pinning to rwd-v2.3.0 as immediate customer workaround. For platform fix: rolling patch to v2.3.1 formatter is in progress (INF-2345-PR1) — ETA 6 hours for canary. I'll add a config override on Dedicated to set `format_strict:true` per-customer; engineering will coordinate with infra to apply for AcmeCorp as mitigation. I'll also add a regression test to the structured-output suite.

Jordan L.: I'll prepare comms: tell AcmeCorp we investigated, root cause is a formatter regression in v2.3.1 affecting edge tokenization boundaries for structured outputs. Workarounds: 1) pin to rwd-v2.3.0 (recommended for lowest latency), 2) enable `format_strict:true` (safe but +~40ms). We'll provide a 2-hour update cadence until fixed. Legal / SLA note: we are within response SLA but this is a customer-impacting bug; Ops to file incident and flag for priority credit consideration after fix if required.

Alex K.: I'll message the customer now with both options and link to the support ticket. Also asked them if they can tolerate 40ms overhead; they said yes for the short term. Thanks Samir, Jordan. Please ping when canary is green.
Support Bot: Ticket INF-2345 status updated: assigned -> eng-investigating. Canary deployment started for rwd-v2.3.1-formatter-fix on infra/staging at 1742103720. Updates will be posted here.
Samir P.: Canary looks good on staging (no invalid JSON observed in 100/100 runs). Rolling to canary prod pool now. I'll post back with timestamps and whether we see improved parse success rate.
